preconditions.description: The number of rows R must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of columns C must be between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= matrix[i][j] <= 1 for j in range(C)) for i in range(R))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix must contain either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for i in range(R) for j in range(i+1, R) if matrix[i] == matrix[j])
postconditions.description: The length of the returned list must equal the number of duplicate rows.

postconditions.expression: all(i in return_value for i in range(R) if any(matrix[i] == matrix[j] for j in range(i+1, R)))
postconditions.description: All indices of duplicate rows must be included in the returned list.
